mapper.select: SELECT /* LGUTLC00120.retrieveMenuManualData */ mm.menu_id , mm.menu_name , pm.program_id , pm.program_name , pmn.language_code , pmn.article_write_content AS manual_content , pmn.etc_attach_file_id AS attach_file_id , adi.file_id , adi.file_name FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N pmn , LGCOM_PROGRAM_M pm , LGCOM_MENU_M_V mm , LGCOM_ATTACH_FILE_INFO adi WHERE pmn.program_id = pm.program_id AND pmn.program_id = mm.program_id AND pmn.etc_attach_file_id = adi.file_group_id(+) AND mm.menu_id = #{manualMenuId} AND pmn.program_id = #{manualProgramId} AND pmn.language_code = #{manualLanguageCode} AND mm.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode}
mapper.update: MERGE INTO /* LGUTLC00120.saveManualData */ LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N a USING ( SELECT #{manualProgramId} AS program_id , #{manualLanguageCode} AS language_code , #{manualContent,jdbcType=CLOB} AS article_write_content , #{manualAttachFileId} AS etc_attach_file_id , #{USER_SESSION.applicationUserId} AS user_id FROM DUAL ) b ON (a.program_id = b.program_id AND a.language_code = b.language_code) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET article_write_content = b.article_write_content , etc_attach_file_id = b.etc_attach_file_id , last_updated_by = b.user_id , last_update_date = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT(program_id,language_code,article_write_content,etc_attach_file_id, created_by,creation_date,last_updated_by,last_update_date) VALUES(b.program_id,b.language_code,b.article_write_content,b.etc_attach_file_id, b.user_id,SYSDATE,b.user_id,SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT /* LGUTLC00120.retrieveMenuManualViewData */ NVL(mul.program_id,mst.program_id) AS program_id , NVL(mul.language_code,mst.language_code) AS language_code , mul.article_write_content AS manual_content , mul.etc_attach_file_id , mul.file_id , mul.file_name , CASE WHEN (mul.article_write_content IS NULL OR LENGTH(mul.article_write_content) = 0) AND (mul.file_id IS NULL OR mul.file_id < 0) THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS exist_manual FROM ( SELECT #{manualProgramId} AS program_id , common_code AS language_code , sort_order_no FROM LGCOM_COMMON_CODE_C WHERE code_type_code = 'LGCOM_LANGUAGE_CODE' AND use_flag = 'Y' AND (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= SYSDATE) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= SYSDATE) ) mst , ( SELECT puh.program_id , puh.language_code , puh.article_write_content , puh.etc_attach_file_id , adi.file_id , adi.file_name FROM LGCOM_PROGRAM_USE_HELP_N puh , LGCOM_ATTACH_FILE_INFO adi WHERE puh.etc_attach_file_id = adi.file_group_id(+) AND puh.program_id = #{manualProgramId} ) mul WHERE mst.program_id = mul.program_id(+) AND mst.language_code = mul.language_code(+) ORDER BY mst.SORT_ORDER_NO, mst.program_id
